title: ai_prep_search supports plain text and markdown input (Beta)
body:
The `ai_prep_search()` SQL function now accepts plain text and markdown `STRING` content in addition to the structured `VARIANT` output of [`ai_parse_document`](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/functions/ai_parse_document). You can now chunk and prepare text that you already have as a string for AI Search indexing and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, without first running it through document parsing.

See [`ai_prep_search` function](/aws/en/sql/language-manual/functions/ai_prep_search).
